### Analyst, Investments
Investments - London, London, City of (Hybrid)
---
About 17Capital
17Capital is a private credit manager, specializing in NAV finance for the private equity industry. It provides non-dilutive capital to high-quality private equity management companies, funds, and institutional investors as part of their toolkit for value creation and portfolio management.
Founded in 2008, 17Capital has completed over 130 investments, deploying more than $20 billion alongside leading private equity franchises globally.
For more information, please go to www.17capital.com
Overview
The Investment team, a single team across both preferred equity and credit strategies, is responsible for the origination and execution of investments and consists of more than 30 professionals across New York and London.
Under the supervision of mid-level investment professionals, the Investment Analyst will take a role in sourcing, analysis, execution and monitoring of both preferred equity and credit investments, working on both US and European transactions as required.
Role & Responsibilities
Screen & analyse investment opportunities:
* Review preliminary information and conduct due diligence on underlying portfolio (by fund and/or company)
* Analysis of underlying portfolio managers, strategy, track record and investor base
* Build companies’ performance projections and cash flow models
* Assist in structuring and pricing of transactions and return underwriting
* Write summary investment memos and help the team to present to investment committee
* Assist in transaction execution and legal process
Monitoring existing portfolio:
* Review information received on existing investments
* Coordinate with investee managers when required
* Write investment reviews for quarterly reporting
Deal origination & marketing:
* Support the preparation of deal sourcing, fundraising, and investor update materials
* Screen, identify, and build relationships with appropriate deal flow targets
* Track and analyse performance of origination and marketing strategies
* Prepare materials for and participate in deal origination meetings
Other:
* Support the company’s values and culture
* Participate in strategic sessions and company offsites
* International travel as required for deal origination, monitoring and execution purposes
*This job description is subject to the terms and conditions of an employee’s Employment Contract and associated policies. The employee shall perform such duties that are not written here as the Company may reasonably require.*
Skillset required
* One (1) to three (3) years of experience in investment banking, leveraged finance, private credit, private equity secondaries, and/or equivalent experience
* Excellent academic credentials
* Outstanding analytical skills and attention to detail
* Good financial knowledge and basic aptitude in financial modelling
* A critical thinker with an active interest in alternative investment space
* A team player who is able to work in a collaborative, fast paced environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with willingness to present to small groups
* Fluency/professional proficiency in English with other languages as a plus
* Able to demonstrate honesty, integrity, and professionalism
We offer you:
* Career development, including comprehensive in-house training programme
* Opportunity to learn and grow whilst making a meaningful contribution to the continued expansion of 17Capital during an exciting time of the firm’s overall growth phase
* Opportunity to work on innovative and high-profile transactions with leading global financial sponsors
* Competitive reward and benefits
17Capital's values
Our values are the basis on which we build strong relationships with our clients, our investors and each other. They are the foundation of our business and integral to our continued ability to pioneer success.
Build trust – We behave and act in ways that earn trust
Embrace “different” – We embrace new ideas and constantly strive to discover new ways of doing things
Make things happen – We are agile and responsive in a way that delivers success for all our stakeholders
Strive for excellence – We act with professionalism and adhere to our high standards
*17Capital is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexuality, gender identification, or physical ability. If you have a disability and need an adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please contact recruitment@17capital.com.*

# Campaigns Content Specialist
* **Salary:** £38,777 - £40,496
* **Location:** UK - Nationwide
* **Reporting to:** Social Media Campaigns Manager
* **Hours:** Full Time
* **Contract:** Permanent
* **Closing date:** 09/10/2026
This is a full-time role at 38 Degrees, working 32 hours a week Monday to Thursday, on a four-day week model (except in the weeks that UK Bank Holiday falls on a Monday, where working arrangements are Tuesday to Friday).
**All colleagues work a four-day week**; colleagues receive 100% of salary for 80% of the typical working week.
**Working Arrangements:** 38 Degrees operates a variety of working arrangements and employees can agree to work remotely from home in a location within the UK. Employees can also work on an ad hoc basis, or hybrid if they are based in London (with occasional travel to London if not London-based). Please note that we hold a number of in-person team events and retreats each year, in locations across the UK. Employees are normally expected to attend these events, with flexibility and reasonable adjustments available.
**Closing date: Friday 9th October at 9am**
**About the role**
We’re looking for a creative, passionate, skilled content creator and campaigner, to produce content for our social media channels which informs, persuades and mobilises our audiences to take action. Reporting to our Social Media Campaigns Manager, you will create campaigning content which will drive change in the UK, making our country fairer, more respectful and more sustainable.
This role will have a particular focus on producing video content – both as a presenter and editor. We are looking for creators who are experienced in producing content for Instagram Reels and TikTok, knowledgeable about social media trends, comfortable on camera and adept at producing vertical video — and want to use those skills to make a difference on the biggest issues impacting people’s lives across the country.
This job is for you if you’re passionate about making the country fairer, more respectful, and more sustainable – and have the skills and drive to create content and develop social media-led campaign tactics which make people want to get involved, join us and take action. We’re looking for someone who has both the content creation skillset and knowledge of current affairs to translate complex issues into entertaining content. You will have a collaborative approach, be able to build strong relationships across teams and be comfortable working in a fast, reactive environment, where content is often developed, crafted and published in response to breaking news.
There are no formal education requirements for this role. As long as you can show us that you have the skills, we don’t mind where you got them from! To be successful in your application you must meet the requirements of this role and complete the task below which are part of the selection criteria. Without completion of this task your application cannot be considered.
**Your background and experience**
We are looking for someone who understands our organisation and theory of change, and shares both our passion for great content and our determination to change the country for the better.
You will have worked at or with similar organisations or built your own profile creating content around social and political issues. You’ll have experience creating both graphic and video content and knowledge of the design and editing tools needed to create social media content.
You will be a sharp copywriter, skilled in writing social native copy and have excellent knowledge of social media trends. You will likely have experience presenting video content – or are keen to develop this skillset and create more content on-camera.
You will have a keen interest in social media, stay across the ever changing social landscape, have lots of content creators you follow and can draw ideas and inspiration from, and believe in the ability to use social media to genuinely change minds and make people take action which matters.
You’ll be passionate about campaigning and have a sharp understanding of the power of social media to mobilise large numbers of people in support of campaigns. As part of this team you’ll regularly be involved in developing campaign tactics as well as content, and helping to upskill the wider team on the opportunities that social media campaigning presents.
**Full job description: Salary Scale E – Campaigns Content Specialist**
**About us**
38 Degrees is a community of more than a million people who – in a moment away from their busy days – take small actions on issues they care about, which all add up to something bigger, a movement for a better Britain for everyone who calls our country home.
A Britain where we all get a fair chance in life and where the place we were born, or the area we live in, doesn’t decide that chance. Where we protect our planet and hold those in power to account for doing the same, and where we are treated, and treat one another, with respect.
In the space of a week, millions of supporters could be campaigning on anything from protecting our NHS and stopping cuts to Universal Credit, to saving local green spaces and protecting our democracy.
38 Degrees is fiercely independent. We are primarily funded by small donations from hundreds of thousands of members of the public from all over the UK. This independence means we never have to hold ourselves back from taking on those with power and can truly listen to our supporters.
**Benefits of working for 38 Degrees**
38 Degrees’ approach to total rewards (salaries, rewards and benefits) is rooted in our Compensation Philosophy which defines our principles and the criteria to ascertain whether decisions on pay and reward meet those principles – our ultimate aim is to attract and retain a talented, driven team, and reward all of us for the impactful work we do in a way which is fair, equitable and sustainable, based on this philosophy and our vision to make the UK fairer, more respectful and more sustainable.
38 Degrees employee salaries, rewards and benefits are benchmarked against the UK NFP sector.
38 Degrees’ culture is honest, kind, supportive, courageous, and respectful. We move fast, and frequently change plans to respond to events. We work hard but we also have fun.
We regularly enjoy team away days and social hours.
**Additional Benefits (as per the statutory or enhanced qualifying conditions in the staff handbook)**
**Currently we provide:**
* 38 Degrees operates a four-day working week. Our working days are Monday – Thursday. On rare occasions employees may work on a Friday to manage reactive work or communication with organisations that work a five-day week. If a bank holiday falls on a Monday employees are required to work Tuesday – Friday.
* For a four-day working week employees receive 24 days (pro rata) annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) pro rata. The office closes between Christmas and New year, employees do not need to take this additional time from their annual leave allocation.
* Employer pension contribution
* 24 hour employee assistance programme
* Family leave policies (some with enhancements)
* Employer paid annual flu vaccination
* Rental deposit loan
* Contribution to eye tests/glasses
* Learning and development budget
**We are developing the following benefits which we will communicate when finalised:**
* One month paid sabbatical leave as per policy terms after 5 years of service
* Cycle to work scheme
* IVF
* Menopause
* Religious leave
* Surrogacy
* Parental Bereavement Leave
* Global Remote working
**Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
We’re especially keen to hear from people who’ll bring lived experience of the issues we work on and who’ll make our team more diverse as a result. So if you’re Black, Asian or from any other minority ethnic group, if you’re disabled, LGBTQIA+, or if you’re from a working class home, your application will be especially welcome. And thanks to our flexible home working approach and network of offices, we have a staff team that is increasingly based across the UK. A third of us live outside London. We’re keen to continue diversifying geographically, so that we’re rooted in our supporters’ communities.
To make sure that we are able to reach our goal of a diverse team we have equal opportunities monitoring requirements. Your application will not be complete without the equal opportunities monitoring form.
38 Degrees is committed to inclusive working practices, so during the application process we commit to:
* Paying for childcare whilst you’re at 38 Degrees interviews or tasks.
* Paying for your travel costs to the office and back – and for overnight accommodation if you’re travelling from a long distance for an interview although at present the majority of interviews are held online.
* Making any reasonable adjustments – for example ensuring we have a BSL interpreter organised in advance if you’d need one.
* If there is anything else you’re concerned about or think we could provide, please let us know.
To be successful in your application you must meet the essential requirements for this role and answer the questions below which are part of the selection criteria. Without completion of this task your application cannot be considered.
The successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK at the time of appointment.
Please see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice here: https://home.38degrees.org.uk/job-applicant-privacy-notice/
You can apply for this role by emailing your CV **and the answers to the questions below** (of no more than 2 pages) to recruitment@38degrees.org.uk
**Application questions (max. word count: 2000 words across all questions)**
1. What do you think are the key components of a successful campaigning social media video?
2. What is a social media campaign you’ve seen that was particularly successful at getting audiences to take action? Why do you think it is successful?
3. Please share example(s) of social videos or posts you’ve created that you’re particularly proud of. What was the process that went into creating it/them?

This is a rare opportunity to help redesign a tech stack, develop a best practice AI-enabled software development model with the highest technical standards and deliver a sector-leading set of tools for one of the biggest campaigning organisations in the UK.

You will have experience developing software using AI tools, and be brimming with ideas about how a small technology team can make the most of tools like Claude Code to multiply our impact and how you’ll use your influence in the team to make that happen.
**You’re someone who understands the discipline around leading and maintaining a product, not just working across technologies.** You are creative and curious when it comes to solving business problems, comfortable asking users “why” and understanding what they are trying to achieve, and you enjoy collaborating to identify and deliver the best technical solutions. You understand the non-profit campaigning domain we’re operating in, or you’re excited to learn. You demonstrate the specific technical expertise the role requires while also applying product-outcomes-thinking best practice to work effectively with end users.
You are a patient and clear communicator with non-technical stakeholders, and you’re motivated by achieving real lasting business impact and collaboratively solving business problems with users rather than simply delivering requested features. You’re driven by the opportunity to build best-in-class campaign tools and deliver professional, high-quality work that makes our tech products a joy for users and supporters to interact with.
You are flexible, as comfortable responding to short-notice reactive requests and staying cool-headed in a crisis as you are pushing forward longer-term product development work. And finally – you’ll need a passion for being part of our mission to make the country a fairer, more respectful, more sustainable place, and a hunger to give our supporters the power to help make that happen.

## Description
**About the role:**
We are on the lookout for a Senior Womenswear designer to join our design team on a fixed term basis during an exciting period of growth for the brand.
The Senior Fashion Designer leads the creative direction of collections, ensuring brand consistency across all ranges. This role works cross-functionally with key departments —including buying, marketing, and garment technology — to drive commercial success while mentoring and developing junior members of the design team.
**Your Responsibilities:**
• Set the overall creative direction and vision for collections, ensuring consistency with brand strategy and long-term goals
• Lead seasonal concept development, including shoot concepts and storytelling
• Approve final line-ups, ensuring product range aligns with customer needs and commercial objectives
• Evaluate market trends, consumer behaviour, and competitor activity to drive future design strategies and direction
• Lead high-level supplier relationships and negotiate key developments independently
• Oversee collection planning, ensuring design workstreams align with critical path and business priorities
• Mentor and develop junior designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects
• Collaborate with senior members (Buying, Marketing, Merchandising) to align creative direction
• Lead design reviews and present collections to leadership with clear rationale and vision
• React strategically to trade and performance feedback, driving quick-turn updates or edits to enhance sell-through
## Requirements
· Extensive experience in fashion design, with a strong track record of designing commercially successful womenswear collections
· Demonstrated ability to set and lead creative direction across multiple product categories, with a deep understanding of brand identity and customer profile
· Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with experience managing, coaching, and developing junior designers
· Proven experience conducting market and trend research, with the ability to translate insights into commercially relevant, brand-aligned collections.
· Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), and confident in producing high-quality CADs, moodboards, and presentation materials.
· Strong technical skills in garment construction and product development, including creating and reviewing detailed tech packs and prototypes
· Experience negotiating with suppliers and managing high-level vendor relationships with confidence and professionalism
· Confident in presenting collections and design rationale to leadership and cross-functional teams
· Excellent organisational and project management skills — able to manage multiple deadlines, oversee the critical path, and balance creative output with business priorities
· Collaborative approach with cross-functional teams (Buying, Merchandising, Garment Tech, Marketing), ensuring alignment at all stages of the design and development process
· Resilient, adaptable, and solution-oriented, with a forward-thinking, trend-led design approach

* Birthday day off
* 25-day holiday
* Flexible hours
* Vibrant team
* 40% off staff discount
* Team socials
* Competitions

#### About Aduro
Aduro is an AI-first digital transformation agency. We take clients from where they are to AI-native — understanding their world, building the technical backbone, and rewiring how their teams actually work. We build and manage real software estates for our clients, from e-commerce and quoting engines to community and analytics platforms.
We're radically transparent and deliberately lean: a small core of senior architects and engineers working alongside specialist contractors, with AI handling the busywork and humans keeping judgement in the loop. AI-first, human-led — the standard doesn't drop because the model is faster. Every pull request is reviewed, every cost is visible, and honesty comes as standard, even when it's uncomfortable.
#### The role
We're hiring a Frontend Engineer to own the cosmetic layer of our product — the "frontend of the frontend." Much of our engineering and integration work is now AI-augmented, and this role is focused on where that automation falls short: getting the UI pixel-accurate and faithful to our Figma designs.
You'll work primarily in React, Tailwind CSS and Storybook. Our workflow is AI-first: components and their Storybook stories are generated directly from designs via the Figma MCP integration, and your job is to pick up where that generation falls short — bringing the output into line with the design intent, and making sure components and stories are structured correctly underneath. It's hands-on, detail-driven work, but not narrow — you'll still touch the integration side, and you'll be expected to use your own judgement where the designs leave room for interpretation.
This is a good fit for someone who cares about craft: spacing, alignment, states, responsiveness — the difference between "roughly right" and "exactly right."
#### What you'll do
* Reconcile the live UI against Figma designs, correcting cosmetic and layout discrepancies in AI-generated and existing implementations.
* Review and fix AI-generated components and Storybook stories produced from designs via Figma MCP, ensuring both the rendered UI and the underlying structure are correct.
* Set up stories properly, including wrapping them in the context and providers that downstream components consume, and composing stories with the surrounding UI needed to present a component meaningfully in isolation.
* Restructure and recompose React components where the design requires it, not just tweak styles at the surface.
* Apply sound judgement on Tailwind and CSS where the Figma spec is ambiguous or incomplete.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) to work efficiently through volume, while keeping quality and consistency high.
* Collaborate with design and engineering to keep the implemented product, and the Storybook–Figma integration, aligned with design intent.
#### What we're looking for
* Competent React fundamentals — you can add and remove local state and wrap components in existing context or providers, without needing to orchestrate entire provider trees from scratch. Deeper composition expertise is a plus, not a requirement; AI tooling is part of how we cover broader fundamentals day to day.
* Familiarity with Storybook — comfortable working with component stories as part of the UI workflow.
* Strong Tailwind CSS skills, with the discernment to make sensible calls when a design isn't fully specified.
* Prior experience aligning production UI to Figma at pace — fluent reading and inspecting designs, responsive implementation across breakpoints, and working within design systems or component libraries.
* Interaction and UI states — hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty, and error done properly, not as an afterthought.
* Comfort reaching for plain CSS when Tailwind isn't the right tool — animations, tricky layout, one-off cases.
* Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools (Claude Code and/or Cursor) — you should already be working this way, not learning it on the job.
* Comfort working from tickets and taking ownership of getting things visually correct.
#### Nice to have
* Deep React fundamentals — advanced composition, provider design, and restructuring component trees beyond surface-level changes.
* The nuances of wrapping Storybook stories in context and providers so downstream components render correctly in isolation.
* Experience with the Storybook–Figma integration and/or Figma MCP.
* TypeScript comfort — reading and lightly editing typed React without needing to own architecture.
* Accessibility awareness — sensible focus, semantics, and keyboard behaviour when polishing UI.

## The allsaints team
At AllSaints we are in the business of feelings - making our customers feel cool and confident. If, like us, you believe in the power of a great outfit, we'd love to talk to you.
We're a global brand made up of a very diverse mix of talented people in a huge variety of roles. Our products are designed in house and made by a small number of suppliers and artisans around the world to sustainable standards.
We are a brand embarking on a very exciting plan and we are seeking new members of the team who want to contribute to this.
**THE ROLE**
* As an AllSaints Stylist, you are the fundamental link between our products and customers.
* The majority of the day will be spent on the shop floor, styling and influencing our customers across our busy shop floors, but there will also be an opportunity to gain experience in visual merchandising, general store operations and personal shopping.
* You will work closely with your management team, supporting the store in reaching its targets, selling our collections to our customers and ensuring that our stores are looking fabulous at all times.
* You will be provided with great training tools and product knowledge, and it will be up to you to make the most of it, learning and developing in a brand where opportunities to further progress in a career with AllSaints are there for the taking.

* You will style our customers in our latest collections, sharing your detailed product knowledge and providing them with an exceptional brand experience
* You will actively maintain the store’s aesthetic; ensuring that product is readily available for our customers and that floor sets and standards are upheld at all times
* Stock replenishment, deliveries and digital orders will become part of your day to day, whilst utilising our digital tools to support a positive customer journey
* You will be empowered to make service decisions for our customers to resolve their issue whilst retaining their loyalty and trust
* You will relentlessly put the customer at the heart of everything you do and work as one AllSaints team to get the best result
* You will greet our customers into our store and tailor your approach to support the purpose of their visit

* Awareness and knowledge of our brand, our style and our brand values - you'll support and influence your peers and customers alike
* Can do attitude and lots of enthusiasm - there's a lot of time spent on interacting with customers and colleagues on our busy shop floors

* Tech savvy; you'll be processing a lot of transactions and store deliveries using our in-store digital tools
* You'll be actively aware of brand campaigns, lookbooks and new product launches and a passionate advocate of all things AllSaints

* A confident communicator
* You love fashion! We need you to be an irresistible ambassador for AllSaints and a believer in the power of an amazing new outfit

* Potential to earn more from our team commission scheme

* Bank holidays, birthdays and volunteering days off

* Reproduce silicon-observed behaviours in controlled environments to isolate CPU effects

**The role is responsible for:**
**1. Content publishing and newsletter production.** Provide accurate and timely support for publishing digital content and producing newsletters across the Society’s channels.

* Carry out light content editing and formatting where needed to support publication (there is no expectation of editorial experience or expertise)
* Post vacancies on the Society’s job board and support other routine publishing activity as required.
* Help maintain high standards of accuracy, consistency and accessibility across published digital content and email communications.
* Organise digital assets and maintain content libraries.

* Provide first-line IT and AV support to staff, helping to resolve routine issues and escalating more complex or urgent issues promptly when required.

* Generate routine reports using tools such as Google Analytics and Dynamics CRM, and help colleagues access the information they need for day-to-day decision-making and monitoring.

* Contribute to the smooth running of the Society’s digital operations by supporting practical system-related tasks across the team.

* Monitor shared inboxes and respond to or route routine queries appropriately, ensuring urgent or important issues are escalated promptly.
* Undertake general administration to support the work of the Digital and Content Team and related activity across the Society.
* Create and maintain user guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and other practical documentation to support consistent ways of working.
* Keep records, documents and shared information organised and up to date so that colleagues can work efficiently and consistently.

* Answer incoming calls and provide first-line customer service alongside other colleagues.
* Respond to, or arrange responses from colleagues to, incoming queries in corporate inboxes.
* Prepare mailing lists for emails, surveys or newsletters from the CRM.
* Support colleagues with webinars and events where needed.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the RSS and provide practical support to members and volunteers where relevant.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy, professionalism and customer service in all aspects of the role.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying straightforward ways to improve processes, reduce avoidable issues and make routine tasks easier for users and colleagues.
* Attend meetings and events related to the role, and the Digital and Content Team.
* Provide cover for leave (if required and where relevant to experience).
* Undertake such other duties as may reasonably be required, consistent with the level and purpose of the role.

**Pension and benefits**

A training budget, season ticket loan, cycle to work scheme and employee assistance programme are also available.
**Location**
The RSS office is in central London. We offer flexible working arrangements, and this is a hybrid role with a minimum two days a week working in the office. In-person attendance for key meetings, team activity and practical support needs will be required.
**Working hours**
Full-time (35 hours per week/5 days a week). Flexibility will be required, including occasional support outside normal working hours, to help with webinars, online meetings or other digital activity.

25 days per annum, plus bank holidays and an additional shut down between Christmas and New Year (pro rata for part-time posts).

Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.

## Job Description
**Join Our Dynamic Team as a Marketing Executive!** 🌟
Are you passionate about telecoms? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customer’s most trusted advisor for cloud-based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!
**What will you be doing?**
Support the execution of Babble's events programme and help build our social media presence, primarily on LinkedIn where our SMB IT and business-owner audience is. Events is a support and delivery role — the Brand & Communities Manager owns event strategy and planning, but this person is our ambassador on the day: confident, front-of-house, representing Babble to customers and prospects. Social carries more room to grow: we expect the postholder to take on increasing ownership of day-to-day direction over time. Both generate data and content that feed our wider AI-driven marketing infrastructure — this is a role expected to use data to improve how it works, not just report on it.
**Accountabilities and Deliverables:**
* Support the planning, coordination and delivery of Babble's events programme — the Brand & Communities Manager owns event strategy and direction; this role executes it.
* Assist with logistics, administration, supplier coordination and attendee communications.
* Manage event documentation, schedules and project plans to keep delivery on track.
* Attend events to support setup, on-the-day running and pack- down.
* Act as an ambassador for Babble at events — confident, front-of-house, and comfortable representing the brand to customers and prospects without direct supervision.
* Assist with post-event reporting, feedback collection and performance analysis.
* Capture attendee and engagement data in a consistent, usable format for the wider marketing function.
* Support development of, then increasingly help shape, the social content calendar alongside the Brand & Communities Manager — primarily LinkedIn, where our SMB IT and business-owner audience is.
* Produce content across formats, using AI tools to speed up production.
* Schedule, publish and monitor content across channels.
* Measure performance against business value, not reach — and use the data to change what's done next.
* Expected to take on more ownership of day-to-day social direction as capability and confidence grow.
* Support wider marketing projects and campaign assets as needed.
**Core Competencies:**
* Organisation and attention to detail — this is an execution role, delivered reliably to a brief.
* Comfortable following direction and flagging issues early, rather than setting event strategy.
* Poise and presence with customers face to face — composed, personable and professional with no script and no one standing over them.
* Able to write and adapt content for a professional B2B audience, not just a personal or consumer one.
* AI-native: uses tools to work faster without being told to.
* More scope here to grow into a leading role than in events
* Proactive; comfortable working independently and in a team.
**Key Performance Indicators**
* Event attendee and engagement data captured to a standard usable elsewhere in the business — target and format to be agreed in first 90 days.
* Social content performance reported against business-value measures (e.g. engagement quality, click-through, lead touches), not reach or likes alone.
* At least one documented example per quarter of a format, channel, or timing decision changed because of performance data.
**Working Arrangements**
This is a Wakefield-based role, and the successful candidate will be expected to work from our Wakefield office a minimum of two days per week alongside the Brand & Communities Manager.
The role also includes supporting events and community activities across the UK. While travel will not typically be required on a weekly basis, there will be occasions where travel is necessary to support event delivery. This may involve travel outside of normal working hours and, on occasion, overnight stays. As a result, a full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle are essential requirements for this position.
**What You'll Gain**
* A fantastic opportunity to begin your career in marketing.
* Hands-on experience across events, social media and marketing.
* Mentorship and support from an experienced Brand & Communities Manager and Marketing team.
* Exposure to a wide range of marketing activities and projects.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your marketing career.
* A collaborative and supportive working environment.
We're looking for someone enthusiastic, proactive and eager to build a career in marketing. Above all, you'll be highly organised and detail-oriented — event delivery relies on excellent planning and coordination, so this matters more than anything else on this list.
## Qualifications
* A genuine passion for marketing and a desire to build a career in the industry.
* Strong interest in social media, content creation and digital marketing.
* Exceptional organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and priorities effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive approach and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team.
* Confident representing Babble face to face at events, unsupervised — comfortable as the front-of-house presence with customers and prospects.
* Confidence using social media platforms in a professional capacity, and able to write and adapt content for a professional B2B audience, not just a personal or consumer one.
* Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day, and keen to find ways they can make your own work faster or better — this isn't a role for someone who just wants tasks handed to them.
* Comfortable working with data and analytics — able to read performance numbers, draw a conclusion from them, and show a concrete example of having changed an approach based on what the data told them.
* Full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle.
* Willingness to travel nationwide to support events and marketing activities when required.
**What else looks good for this role:**
* A degree or qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related subject. We will consider other degrees but proof of interest/ experience will be a must.
* Experience creating content for social media, whether through work, education, personal projects or voluntary activities.
* Experience using content creation or design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar, plus any exposure to AI content or automation tools (e.g. Canva AI, ChatGPT, Claude).
* Familiarity with social media management and scheduling platforms such as HubSpot or similar tools.
* Experience supporting events, projects or organised activities.
* Understanding of social media best practice and content planning.
* Experience with analytics or reporting tools (e.g. native platform analytics, Google Analytics, HubSpot reporting) is a bonus, though we're more interested in the thinking than the specific tool.
## Additional Information
**Why work for Babble?**
* Company Pension
* 22 days holiday Balance + UK Bank Holidays - with increased annual leave based on length of service
* Life Assurance – 4x Annual Salary
* Optional Health Insurance – Bupa
* Optional Health Cash Plan – Health Shield
* £1,000 payment after 10 years service
* Bike to Work Scheme
* Season Ticket Commuter Loan
* Charities Trust – Donations to charities pre tax
* Annual Company Celebrations

You will be contracted to work from the office however, Babble operates a non-contractual Hybrid Working Policy whereby you will be required to be in the office on company anchor days (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday) and will be able to work from home on Wednesday and Friday. Job Title
Senior Data and Operations Analyst - Private Companies
Department
Private Companies Operations-Investment Specialist-UK
Overview of Department
.
Purpose of Role
The purpose of this role is to strengthen the Private Companies business through high-quality data, analytics and management information across the lifecycle of the investment whilst also supporting operational elements of deal flow. This is a hands-on role responsible for the quality and usability of data within the Private Companies team, maintaining and developing our analytical and reporting capability, and providing insights to support departmental decision-making.
The role will work across portfolio company financial information, valuations, investment activity and fund administration data across multiple vehicles, along with client and prospect reporting. Power BI will be central, with responsibility for maintaining and enhancing reporting, developing new analytical solutions and helping colleagues turn data into clear, actionable insight.
The role will also own the development of the Private Companies deal management process, establishing a consistent approach to capturing, tracking and analysing deal activity from initial opportunity through to execution.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Reporting
Take day-to-day responsibility for the quality, completeness and usability of key Private Companies datasets.
Monitor data completeness and consistency across systems, ensuring material gaps or discrepancies are identified and resolved.
Reconcile information from different systems and third-party sources where required.
Build, maintain and improve Power BI dashboards covering areas such as portfolio performance, valuations, investment activity and deal flow.
Improve the efficiency and consistency of client and prospect data requests to better support both internal and external stakeholders.
Improve reporting processes by replacing manual and fragmented activity with repeatable, automated and controlled solutions.
Support recurring and ad hoc information requirements across the Private Companies team.
Oversee and maintain company and instrument records.
Analysis and Insight
Use Private Companies data to identify trends, risks and opportunities relevant to departmental decision-makers.
Provide insight and interpretation rather than simply producing management information.
Work with investment, operational and leadership colleagues to translate business questions into useful analysis.
Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Proactively identify opportunities where better use of data could improve decision-making or business efficiency.
Operations and Continuous Improvement
Build and maintain the data and reporting layer of the Private Companies deal management process, giving clear visibility of activity from initial opportunity through to completion.
Ensure transactions, corporate actions, IPOs and transfer-agent activity are accurately captured in relevant systems and records.
Act as the Private Companies business-side subject matter expert for the data model across key platforms including iLevel, Snowflake and the deal-management environment.
Improve reconciliation of investment, transaction and fund-level data against fund administrators and other third-party records across multiple vehicles.
Ensure the data environment is scalable for new funds, structures, distribution channels, administrators and reporting requirements.
Develop practical solutions to inefficient or fragmented processes.
Explore appropriate uses of automation and AI in data collection, analysis and reporting.
Work with technology and enterprise data teams where changes to underlying systems or data platforms are required.
What success looks like:
A trusted and well-structured Private Companies data universe, with clear ownership and definitions.
High-quality Power BI and management reporting that supports decision-making, delivered with materially less manual effort.
Clear visibility across the Private Companies deals pipeline and investment activity.
More efficient and consistent delivery of data to internal stakeholders, clients and prospects.

Strong experience as a data analyst, business intelligence analyst or in a comparable analytical role.
Experience working with private companies, private equity, private markets or closely related investment data.
Strong Power BI capability, including dashboard development and management reporting.
Strong analytical skills and experience working with complex financial datasets.
Experience reconciling multiple data sources and investigating data-quality issues.
Ability to turn data into clear conclusions, insights and recommendations.
Strong problem-solving skills and enthusiasm for developing practical solutions.

# Senior FP&A Analyst
Liverpool
### **About Behavox**
Behavox is a cloud-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front-office analytics on a single, AI-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS-based cloud service.
At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.
Behavox is a high-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end-to-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.
Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.
### **About the Role**
The Senior FP&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.
The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.
This is a high-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.
### **What You'll Bring**
1. **Financial Model & Accounting Foundations** — Understands the architecture of integrated three-statement and operating models and the accounting that underpins them, including SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment. Understands how the company's budgets are built and how to integrate them accurately into the core financial model.
2. **Forecasting & SaaS Unit Economics** — Understands bottom-up short-term forecasting, driver-based long-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that reveal business performance. Connects movements in those metrics to their underlying drivers and the operating levers that can change them.
3. **Mergers, Acquisitions & Integration** — Understands acquisition valuation, purchase accounting, combined-entity projections, and consolidation mechanics sufficiently to evaluate targets and integrate completed acquisitions into the financial model.
4. **Business & Commercial Acumen** — Understands in depth how the business and its functions generate revenue and incur costs, including the underlying revenue drivers, cost structure, and operating levers. Applies this knowledge to identify inconsistencies and challenge financial results and assumptions.
5. **Financial Systems & AI Tooling** — Understands Google Sheets, Excel, AI, and automation capabilities sufficiently to determine how they should be applied to financial modeling and analysis. Distinguishes where automation can improve speed and control from where financial judgment and manual validation must remain.
### **What You'll Do**
1. **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three-statement and operating model using robust architecture, accounting logic, scenario and sensitivity layers, and integrated budgets, owning the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption to provide reliable forecasts and analysis for company planning and decision-making.
2. **Acquisition Modeling & Integration** — Builds valuations, scenarios, and pro-forma combined-entity models by independently evaluating targets, supporting due diligence, and consolidating closed deals to provide a complete financial view of acquisition implications and the combined business.
3. **Business-Review Reporting** — Drives the financial substance of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews with the broader FP&A team by translating model outputs and performance drivers into a clear narrative that enables senior management, the board, and investors to understand results and their implications.
4. **Metrics Analysis & Business Partnering** — Diagnoses financial and SaaS metric movements by identifying operating drivers, pressure-testing assumptions, and modeling relevant levers and downside cases to give decision-makers evidence-based recommendations they can act on.
5. **AI-Enabled Productivity** — Applies AI and spreadsheet automation to recurring financial workflows by automating appropriate work and strengthening data validation while retaining judgment over what remains manual to reduce cycle time without compromising financial integrity.
### **What We Offer**
* The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies
* A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence
* A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families
* A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance
### **About Our Process**
We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies. The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.
### **Please note that:**
* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

In this role, you’ll work closely with colleagues across DK and PRH, including Technology, Data and Analytics, Commercial Insights, Finance, Operations and Production, Online Marketplace, and Sales teams.
The role
As Data Engineer, you’ll design, build and maintain reliable, secure and reusable data pipelines, models and automation for DK. You’ll help to make trusted data available for reporting, analytics and operational workflows, essentially making it easier for DK teams to access, understand and use data confidently.
Reporting to the Head of Data Engineering, you’ll work with tools and platforms such as Snowflake, Python, SQL, dbt, Fivetran, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub and cloud services. You’ll also support strong data governance, documentation, monitoring and service quality. This role would suit someone who enjoys solving practical data problems, working with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and building solutions that are robust, scalable and genuinely useful.
What you’ll be doing
Key responsibilities: Build and manage data pipelines so that data can move reliably between systems and be used for reporting, analytics and day to day operations.
Maintain DK’s Snowflake data environment, including data models, schemas, performance, and data quality controls.
Bring together data from different internal and external sources and make sure it is secure, accessible and aligned with PRH data standards.
Automate manual data and reporting processes using cloud tools, GitHub and other services to improve efficiency and reliability.
Manage CI/CD processes for data solutions, making sure development is properly tested, documented and moved between environments safely.
Support BI and reporting needs, working with analysts and stakeholders on dashboards, reports and tools such as Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
Create clear documentation including technical notes, data definitions and service transition materials.
Support testing, incident resolution and performance monitoring for DK data solutions.
Lead technical conversations and reviews, sharing best practice across data engineering, automation, data modelling and BI.

Work closely with Data Governance, making sure monitoring, alerting and metadata are kept up to date,

Essential criteria:
Strong experience in data engineering, business intelligence development or data platform engineering, with a proven track record of designing, building and supporting scalable data integration solutions.
Strong knowledge of Snowflake and other cloud data platforms, including schema design, data modelling, secure access and performance management.
Excellent SQL skills, ideally within Snowflake, including data extraction, transformation, analysis, performance optimisation and working with large, structured datasets.
Strong Python skills for data processing, automation and integration, with the ability to build maintainable, well documented solutions.
Practical experience of building and managing data pipelines using ETL or ELT frameworks, with knowledge of tools such as dbt, Fivetran or similar.
Understanding of BI data modelling and reporting tools, such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or Looker, including how to structure data for reporting and self-service analytics.
Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, translate business needs into data solutions, and support the accurate use of data across an organisation.
A good understanding of data governance, data quality, privacy and compliance considerations, with an appreciation of how these apply to reliable and responsible data use.
Familiarity with cloud services, deployment practices or CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or similar, would be helpful.
You’ll be collaborative and inclusive, able to build trusted relationships across DK, PRH, technical teams, analysts and business stakeholders.
You’ll take ownership of problems and follow through to delivery, balancing pace with quality, security and long term maintainability.

Some experience of mentoring colleagues, contributing to technical design discussions or reviewing the work of other data professionals would be beneficial.

## **In a nutshell**
Most engineering roles ask you to build features. This one asks you to help build revenue through technical partnerships and marketplace integrations that embed BrightLocal's value into the platforms our customers already use, rather than waiting for them to come to us.
You'll sit within the Sales team, working directly with our CCO, and wear two hats. Every integration you build flattens the cost of winning customers and compounds our reach, so this is a role where the commercial impact of your work is easy to see.
It's a great move if you want more ownership than a typical engineering role gives you: you'll carry partner relationships end to end, not just write the code behind them, and you'll have real support to grow into the parts of it you haven't done before.

**Pre-sales technical consultancy**
* Be the technical partner in the room, and behind it, as API partnerships and agency deals grow larger and more complex.

* Answer the technical, security and data questions that move deals forward
* Translate between commercial and technical, helping account teams turn a partner's needs into a credible solution
* Build proofs of concept and tailored demos that let a prospect see their integration working before they commit
**Technical onboarding and integration delivery**
* Own the technical onboarding of new API partners and agencies, from OAuth and API access to data mapping and go-live
* Build the connectors and data flows that bring a partner's business and location data into BrightLocal, and surface our insights and actions back where they need them
* Document integrations well and hand over cleanly, so what you build is supportable and repeatable
**Distribution partnerships: technical delivery for the CCO**
* Partner with the CCO to deliver the distribution strategy: as you build relationships with marketplaces and platforms, you build the apps and integrations that make them live
* Own the technical relationship with each partner through delivery, from kickoff to go-live
* Ship marketplace apps on BrightLocal's APIs, starting with Jobber (OAuth install, business data in, our report and action layer out, Braintree checkout), and extending to the wider set of marketplaces and platforms
* Deliver each build where the customer already is, powered by BrightLocal Brain
**Build once, connect anywhere**
* Turn one-off integrations into a repeatable toolkit: reusable patterns for identity, accounts, billing, surfacing, and triggers, so each new partner ships faster than the last
* Build strictly to BrightLocal's design system and existing infrastructure and deployment pipeline, never a parallel stack
* Feed what you learn back into our APIs and the wider platform, so the whole business gets easier to integrate with over time
## **What success looks like**
In your first 90 days, you’ll be up and running: you’ll know our APIs, design system and deployment pipeline, you’ll have partnered on at least one live technical deal or onboarding, and you’ll have shipped or advanced our first marketplace integration as the reference for what comes next.

# Police Officer - Stevenage, Colchester, Southend, Brighton and Guildford
## Job Introduction
**Now recruiting Police Officers across the South East**
**Join British Transport Police through our Police Constable Entry Programme.** *"BTP truly is a unique police* *force* *with a real family* *feel**. We care deeply about what we do; serving the public and* *supporting* *our people. Our work matters.* *If you want to make a positive difference to the millions of people who use the network every day, BTP is the place for you**."* **– Chris Casey, Divisional Commander, London and South East England**
**Become a Police Officer in our B Division**
We are recruiting Police Officers at **Stevenage, Colchester, Southend, Brighton****and****Guildford.** ****\*\* Holding a valid full UK driving licence is essential for all locations included on this advert \*\*** **Please note:****We are only recruiting for the locations specified in this advert. If these locations are not suitable for you, we kindly ask that you wait for a future campaign that aligns better with your preferred location.
### Could this be the role for you?
As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in keeping millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. Working across one of the busiest transport networks in the world, you'll face unique challenges, develop valuable skills and make a real difference to people's lives.
No two days are the same. One moment, you could be supporting a vulnerable person in crisis. The next, you might be responding to an emergency, investigating crime, safeguarding a child, disrupting criminal activity or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life.
This is a career where your actions matter. Every interaction provides an opportunity to protect, support and positively impact the communities we serve.
You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by experienced colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and build a rewarding career.
We offer one of the most competitive starting salary packages for Police Constables in England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to specialise throughout your policing career. **What you'll get in return**
A successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, industry-leading travel benefits, strong family-friendly policies, comprehensive wellbeing support and ongoing opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
* **Starting salary:** **£33,609 (plus additional paid allowances stated below)**, rising year-on-year to **£52,014** after five years
* **South East Allowances**: are dependant on location but are either £3105, £2000 or £1000 depending on location from 1 of training.
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service
* A highly competitive Career Average Revalued Earnings (CARE) pension scheme
* Voucher and incentive schemes, including cycle-to-work and a wide range of retail discounts
* Continued investment in learning, supported by dedicated in-house talent and development teams
* Clear promotion and career development opportunities across a range of policing specialisms
* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests
* Eligibility for the Blue Light Card
* Membership of the Police Federation from day one
* Strong support for work-life balance, including 26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave, alongside paternity leave, carers' leave, adoption leave and special leave provisions
### What we're looking for
You do not need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.
Whether you're changing careers, leaving education, returning to work or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed. There is no single background that makes a great police officer. Some of our officers join directly from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, customer service, retail, hospitality, transportation, the military and many other professions.
What matters most is your integrity, commitment to helping others and willingness to learn. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and can build positive relationships with people from all walks of life.
**Key qualities include:**
* Strong communication skills
* Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
* Empathy and emotional resilience
* The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure
**Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP)**
Successful candidates will join the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), British Transport Police's two-year entry route for new police officers.
You do not need a degree to apply and you will not be required to complete a degree as part of the programme.
PCEP combines classroom learning, remote learning, scenario-based training and practical operational experience to equip you with the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for frontline policing.
During training, you'll learn how to:
* Use policing powers lawfully and effectively
* Prevent and investigate crime
* Protect vulnerable people
* Respond to incidents and emergencies
* Support victims and witnesses
* Keep passengers, railway staff and local communities safe
As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, join a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.
**Entry Requirements**
To be eligible to apply for the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), you must have:
**LEVEL 2**
* Level 2 qualifications in English Language and Maths (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification), **OR**
* be willing to undertake BTP's Level 2 English and Maths assessment if you do not currently hold these qualifications,
**LEVEL 3 OR WORK EXPERIENCE**
**In addition to the above you are also required to have:**
* A Level 3 qualification or above (details below), **OR**
* Have relevant work experience demonstrating an equivalent level of knowledge, responsibility and professional capability (details below)
**Examples of Level 3 qualifications include:**
* Two A-levels at grade E or above (or equivalent, such as a BTEC Level 3, Level 3 T Levels or International Baccalaureate(IB)).
* BTEC National Diploma
* NVQ Level 3
* Access to Higher Education Diploma
* Other recognised Level 3 qualifications
* Policing experience: at least 12 months' relevant experience, including service as a Special Constable (independent patrol status), PCSO and staff. **OR**
**Work Experience**
We recognise that qualifications are only one measure of potential. If you do not hold a Level 3 qualification, we may consider relevant work experience as an alternative route into policing.
Relevant work experience (24 months service) in one of the following areas:
* Armed Forces / Military service
* Emergency services (e.g. ambulance, fire)
* Revenue Protection Officer / Revenue Inspector
* Railway Enforcement Officer
* Rail Incident Response or Service Delivery Management roles
Candidates will be required to provide evidence of their qualifications and/or experience during the recruitment process. **You will not be eligible to apply if:**
* You cannot demonstrate either a Level 3 qualification OR relevant work experience equivalent to Level 3.
* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been declined/refused vetting in the last two years by BTP or any other police force, NCA, CNC or MOD.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.
### Want to apply?
Applications are completed online.
As part of the process, you will be required to complete Situational Judgement Test's. If you do not pass the SJT assessments, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.
You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.
Please note: This campaign is for new recruits only. Transferees should apply through a transferee-specific vacancy when available.
Successful applicants will join a conditional offer pool and be considered for opportunities for up to 12 months from the date of their conditional offer.
### Equality, Diversity and Inclusion
We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive.
We believe our people are strongest when they reflect the diverse communities we serve, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences.
Whatever your background, identity or experience, you'll be supported throughout the recruitment process and throughout your career with British Transport Police.
Reasonable adjustments are available at every stage of the recruitment process.
### Use of AI in applications
AI can be a useful tool for generating ideas or helping structure written responses, but we want to hear your genuine voice. Personal experiences, authentic motivation and individual insight are what stand out most to us.
**Application deadline: Midnight on Monday 16th November 2026**
Please note that this campaign may close early if a high volume of applications is received.
For support or assistance with your application, contact the Recruitment Team - recruitmentteam@btp.police.uk
**Join British Transport Police and build a career where you'll be****supported****, valued and empowered to make a meaningful difference every day****.**

# Police Community Support Officer - Derby
## Job Introduction
**Join us at British Transport Police (BTP) as we recruit PCSOs (Police Community Support Officers) to make a difference in our communities**
*Superintendent David Rams said: "Our Police Community Support officers are an integral part of our British Transport Police family. They carry out vital work across the railway network to keep passengers and staff safe. We care deeply about our Police Community Support officers who deliver an exceptional service to our communities across England and Wales."*
**Is the role for you?**
BTP is seeking PCSOs to join our team, protecting and serving the railway environment and its community to minimise disruption, crime, and fear of crime. This role is crucial to our mission.
Like Home Office PCSOs, BTP PCSOs focus on enforcing BTP Byelaws within the railway environment, offering diverse responsibilities where no two days are the same. Responsibilities include conducting visible patrols at stations, victim care, security threat management, minor crime investigations, community relationship-building, and supporting PCs. **Unlike Home Office police forces, our PCSOs are trained and equipped with handcuffs.**
Ideal candidates should demonstrate resilience, excellent customer service skills, and a passion for community engagement and partnership-building. PCSOs should be prepared to work shifts, including weekends and bank holidays. **Locations**
We are looking for PCSO's within our C Division: Derby.
**In return for your****commitment****, you will receive:**
* Competitive salary: **£29,483.96****rising up to £33,012.03** and up to 20% shift allowance.
* A minimum of 15% shift allowance will be received upon completion of 8 weeks training. Shift allowance can be up to 20% but will default to 15% in the first instance. This will increase year on year, until you reach the top spine point.
* Benefits including 28 rising to 30 days holiday, travel benefits, and access to internal progression opportunities.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities supported by our in-house talent & development teams. Including internal progression to become a Police Officer.
**Are you eligible?**
You will be ineligible to apply if:
* You have been unsuccessful in the last 6 months for the role of PCSO with BTP.
* If you have been unsuccessful following your application or online ability testing for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO, you must await 6 months before reapplying to any of these roles.
* You have been unsuccessful following BTP vetting checks within the last 12 months.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence this includes suspended sentences (other cautions, convictions and involvement with the police must be declared but are not necessarily a bar to employment).
* You have previously been dismissed from another force or you currently have a live investigation.
* You have been declared bankrupt, have a CCJ or an un-managed IVA.
* You have tattoos that are deemed offensive; tattoos on face and neck will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided consistently in the UK for the past 3 years.
**The Pension:**
BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme is administered by Royal London. It’s a defined contribution scheme, offering employees the flexibility to vary their pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of their salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk.
Please note if you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS your pension will not be affected. **Want to apply?**
Apply now! The closing date for applications is midnight on 29th September 2026.
As part of the application process, you will be required to complete a **Situational Judgement Test (SJT)**. Please note that if you do not pass the SJT, your application will not progress further at this time. However, you are welcome to reapply in the future once the reapplication period allows. For further information on eligibility criteria and application process, please refer to the attached recruitment pack. Interviews will be held locally. **It is also advisable to apply after attending a Q&A with the Recruitment Team.**
**This is an ongoing opportunity, so while immediate placement may not be guaranteed, successful applicants will be considered for up to 12 months from when you receive a conditional offer of employment.** **Any questions?**
If you want to ask us any awkward or ‘obvious’ questions, if you are unsure whether your personal circumstances are suitable for a career as a PCSO but don’t know how to talk to us about it or have any questions about the application process, please email our friendly and helpful team where we will be happy to help: RecruitmentTeam@btp.police.uk. To reassure you, anything you ask us will be in the strictest confidence and will not form part of your application.
**AI can be a useful tool to spark ideas or help you organise your thoughts, but when it comes to your application, we want to hear from *you*, not an algorithm. What truly stands out to us are genuine stories, personal insights and the experiences that have shaped who you are. Authenticity matters - it helps us understand your motivations, your strengths and how you’ll contribute to our team. So, use AI if it helps you get started, but let your own voice lead the way.**
**We are****committed****to protecting the public and****supporting****the community. Join the British Transport Police today.**

You will lead the development of a globally consistent approach to Standard Cost Rates, helping BSI better understand the true cost and profitability of the services we deliver to our clients.
Rather than simply analysing existing costs, you will help shape the future model. You will work across the organisation to understand current practices, define clear and consistent costing principles, and translate these into an approach that supports project profitability, gross margin reporting and better commercial decision-making.
Working closely with Commercial Finance, HR and Transformation teams, you will build stakeholder alignment around the new approach and help ensure it can be successfully implemented, governed and maintained within BSI’s future SAP S/4HANA environment.
This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a major global transformation programme, shaping an important area of Finance that will support greater consistency, transparency and insight across BSI.

* Develop clear design principles for how resource costs should be calculated, governed, maintained and applied across BSI.
* Work with Commercial Finance teams to translate the agreed methodology into practical profitability cost rate cards.

**Job Title:** SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Business Analyst
