This is an exciting opportunity to join the Devonshire Group as our Senior Integration & Automation Engineer, taking a leading hands-on role in connecting and modernising the business systems that keep a complex, multi-site organisation running.
# Working alongside the Solutions Delivery & Automation Lead, you will design and deliver the integrations, data flows and automated processes that join up our finance, retail, hospitality, property and operational systems. You will also take our Power Platform estate from ad-hoc solutions to a governed, documented and dependable environment that the whole Group can rely on.
# This is a Microsoft-centred engineering role and the senior technical delivery capability in a small IT team. Where the Lead sets architecture and direction, you will own delivery - designing the solution, building it, integrating it, supporting it and reviewing the work of others. In time you will deputise for the Lead on technical matters, and there is real scope to shape how we work as the function grows.
# This is a full-time role working five days a week from either the Chatsworth Estate Office, near Edensor, Derbyshire or from Bolton Abbey, near Skipton, Yorkshire (with at least one day a week working from the Derbyshire office), depending on your location. Hybrid working will be available with flexibility to meet business needs. There will be some travel to other Devonshire Group locations.
# **What you'll be doing**
* Designing and delivering secure, reliable integrations between business systems, cloud services and third-party platforms using APIs, connectors, middleware and file transfer.
* Building and supporting solutions across Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and SharePoint Online.
* Establishing proper application lifecycle management - environments, managed solutions, Dataverse Git integration, pipelines, release and rollback - and the integration standards the rest of the team builds against.
* Modelling, moving and validating data between systems, and building reporting on top of it using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* Supporting and improving what you and others have built, including through our busiest visitor periods.
* Translating business needs into clear technical designs, and being straight with colleagues about cost, effort and trade-offs.
* Producing high-quality solution designs, technical documentation and support materials that a colleague could pick up.
* Reviewing and mentoring the work of colleagues in IT and citizen developers across the Group.
* Retiring legacy tools and reducing the number of systems we have to keep alive.
* Deputising for the Solutions Delivery & Automation Lead on technical decisions.
# **About you**
You’ll take pride in systems that work reliably for years rather than solutions that demo well. You’ll enjoy untangling how things currently work, spotting where an integration will fail before it does, and leaving behind something a colleague could pick up and support without you.
# You’ll be comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain a constraint to someone who doesn’t want to hear it and keep the relationship intact. You’ll bring a genuine interest in developing others, and the confidence to review a colleague’s design and improve it. * Substantial hands-on experience delivering business system integrations in a Microsoft environment.
* Power Platform experience at solution level - managing environments, managed solutions, ALM, Dataverse and data loss prevention policies, not just building apps and flows.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint Online and Teams.
* Modern integration methods: REST APIs, OAuth 2.0 and Entra ID authentication, standard and custom connectors, middleware, scheduled and event-driven file transfer, and proper handling of failure and retry.
* SQL beyond basic querying, confidence with relational data models, and experience building reporting with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* A track record of supporting systems they built over a period of years, including incident response.
* Evidence of mentoring or developing colleagues, and of reviewing others’ technical work.
* Enough AI literacy to review, integrate, operate and constructively challenge tooling built by others.
* An understanding of security, identity, governance and data protection in cloud environments.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Confident communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues, including explaining a constraint to someone who doesn’t want to hear it.

* Azure integration and data services such as Data Factory, Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid.
* Scripting experience in PowerShell or Python.
* Experience integrating with EPOS, hospitality, property management or finance platforms.
* Experience integrating with a system that was being replaced underneath them.

* A valid UK Driving Licence.

**About the role**
As an Inventory & Materials Coordinator, you'll be responsible for the accurate management, control, reconciliation and reporting of packaging and raw material inventories that support our canning operations. You'll play a key role in maintaining SAP inventory accuracy, ensuring uninterrupted production, safeguarding stock integrity, and supporting compliance with financial, audit and governance requirements.
**Business Context**
Operating within Beer Category Operations, you'll support the production and supply of Diageo's beer portfolio by delivering robust inventory management, material control and SAP transaction governance. Supporting the Belfast Packaging canning production lines, you'll manage the end-to-end administration of packaging and raw material inventories, including cans, trays, lids, pallets and other production components. Inventory & Materials Management
* Maintain accurate inventory records and reconcile SAP stock against physical inventory.
* Process supplier deliveries and goods receipts accurately within SAP.
* Investigate stock discrepancies and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Monitor stock movements, blocked stock and inventory variances.
* Manage production order inventory adjustments and stock reconciliations.
Production Support & SAP Governance
* Support canning operations by ensuring effective material control and component availability.
* Manage SAP inventory transactions, including goods receipts, stock transfers, adjustments, reversals and inventory reporting.
* Monitor production plans and material requirements to support operational continuity.
* Resolve system issues and maintain the integrity of inventory data.
Audit, Compliance & Stock Take Management
* Ensure compliance with inventory governance, financial controls and CARM requirements.
* Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate cycle counts, annual stock takes and inventory investigations.
* Support internal and external audits, including approval processes for inventory adjustments.
Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to improve inventory controls, reporting and stock accuracy.
* Drive process standardisation and operational efficiency.
* Support warehouse and inventory improvement initiatives.
Stakeholder Management
* Build strong relationships with Manufacturing, Planning, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Quality, Warehouse Operations and Line Support teams to ensure inventory accuracy and continuity of supply.
* Collaborate with logistics providers, suppliers, auditors and external partners to resolve inventory, delivery, compliance and reconciliation issues.
People Management
* Provide day-to-day oversight of the Store Operatives responsible for staging and issuing packaging materials to the production lines, ensuring the timely reconciliation of materials used, returns and inventory adjustments.
* Ensure appropriate shift cover is maintained to support operational requirements.
**Experience / skills required:**
* Experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, manufacturing support, people management and supply chain administration.
* Strong knowledge of SAP inventory management and inventory control processes.
* Proven experience managing stock reconciliations, inventory reporting, audit activities and production support within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to investigate root causes, interpret data and identify practical solutions.
* Excellent planning, organisation and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams.
* Understanding of inventory governance, compliance and audit requirements.

# Senior Delivery Health and Safety Manager
**A little bit about us**East West Rail is an infrastructure programme connecting communities between Oxford and Cambridge, a region currently underserved by transport. We have a once in a generation opportunity to improve prosperity for people and places across the corridor.
East West Railway Company was created by the Department for Transport to oversee delivery of East West Rail, from construction through to wheels in motion, ensuring the railway comes together in the right way. **Role Summary**
The Senior Delivery Health and Safety Manager plays a key leadership role within the Health, Safety and Security function, supporting the Director of ETS and the Head of HSS in setting strategic direction, driving consistent standards, and embedding a positive health, safety and security culture across the programme and all delivery operations. The role combines strategic leadership with day-to-day management of the Delivery HSS team, providing direction, coaching and assurance to ensure health, safety and security risks are effectively managed and behaviours align with organisational values. Acting as a trusted partner to the Head of HSS, the role helps translate EWR strategy, guiding principles and the HSMS into delivery, influences senior stakeholders, and leads continuous improvement across the function, delivery teams and suppliers. **Function**
The Health, Safety and Security function sets EWR Co's strategic direction for health, safety and security, working with the Director of ETS and Head of HSS to embed consistent standards and a positive safety culture across the programme and delivery operations. The function provides leadership, coaching and assurance across the Delivery HSS team, and works closely with delivery partners and suppliers to ensure risks are effectively managed.
## Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
* Support the Head of Health, Safety and Security set strategic direction, translating priorities into clear requirements for the Delivery HSS team and ensuring effective implementation against agreed objectives and milestones.
* Act as a senior point of contact for health and safety matters, representing the function at programme, project and leadership forums.
* Shape and maintain governance, assurance and reporting arrangements that give the Executive team confidence in health and safety performance and risk management.
* Provide day-to-day leadership of the Delivery Health and Safety team, including workload planning, prioritisation and performance management, and lead quarterly performance conversations that set clear, measurable objectives.
* Coach and develop team members, building capability, confidence and professional competence across the function.
* Drive a systematic approach to risk management, strengthening assurance frameworks and embedding a proactive safety culture across the business.
* Champion positive safety leadership and behaviours at all levels, setting clear expectations and role-modelling the standards required.
* Maintain oversight of day-to-day Delivery health and safety activity across all projects, providing senior support and constructive challenge in managing incidents, investigations, audits and assurance activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with senior leaders, project teams, delivery partners and external stakeholders, providing pragmatic advice that integrates health, safety and security considerations into planning and delivery.
* Oversee supply chain compliance and performance, ensuring robust governance and consistent delivery of safe, high-quality outcomes across all suppliers.
* Represent the HSS team at key meetings and forums, including Working Groups, PMEC and industry forums, and build relationships with regulators such as the ORR, HSE and Network Rail.
* Promote and embed EWR's Safe and Secure guiding principles across the project lifecycle, acting as a role model and taking responsibility for your own and others' health, safety and security.
## Skills Knowledge and Expertise
**Essential Criteria**
You will bring:
* A background in a senior health and safety leadership role within a complex delivery environment, ideally in infrastructure, construction, rail or utilities.
* Involvement in developing and implementing health and safety management arrangements on large scale, multi-disciplinary rail and major civils projects.
* Skill in leading and managing teams, including coaching, performance management and capability development.
* Strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate strategy into practical, operational delivery.
* Experience embedding culture and behaviour change programmes.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills, with confidence operating at senior leadership level.
* Sound judgement and the ability to provide balanced support and challenge.
* In-depth knowledge of health and safety regulations, standards and best practice.
* A NEBOSH National Diploma for Occupational Health and Safety Management, or an equivalent qualification such as a Diploma in Safety Management (DipSM) from the British Safety Council, or MIRSM.
**Desirable Criteria**
It would also be great if you have:
* A NEBOSH General Certificate, or equivalent experience.
* Assurance, audit or investigation competence.
* Membership of a relevant professional body.
* Knowledge of general health and safety legislation.
* Knowledge of railway-specific legislation and standards, including Railway Group Standards and Network Rail Company Standards, where applicable.
* Confidence using health and safety reporting systems.
## Benefits
* Competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience
* Up to 12% employer pension contribution to support your future
* 36 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the option to buy up to 2 extra days
* 2 volunteering days, a chance for you to give back to the community
* Enhanced family-friendly policies to support you and your loved ones
* Life assurance (4x your annual salary) for peace of mind
* Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support when you need it
* Access to Perkbox for a wide range of discounts and wellbeing benefits
* Recognition programme, including on-the-spot and annual awards
* Advanced learning and development opportunities to help you grow.
**Diversity and Inclusion** At East West Railway Company, we’re committed to building an inclusive railway for all. We believe that to do that, we must nurture a diverse team that represents the UK communities that we impact. Our approach is simple - to create an environment where everyone is welcome and able to be themselves. We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, encouraging applications from all backgrounds and experiences.
If you want to connect lives and unlock the future, then we’d love to hear from you.
## About East West Rail
East West Railway Company is a new and exciting venture at the forefront of the changing landscape of the rail industry, delivering substantial fast-paced improvement to modernise the railway.

About the team
We are seeking a skilled and highly motivated Bioinformatics Developer to join the Human Genomics Team at EMBL-EBI and contribute to the maintenance and development of the DECIPHER platform. DECIPHER is a global data sharing platform that fuels rare disease discovery and enables patient diagnosis. This is an exciting opportunity to join an innovative multi-disciplinary team dedicated to providing tools to assist in the interpretation of genetic variation and the responsible sharing of clinical data for patient benefit. DECIPHER aggregates information from open data resources such as gnomAD and UniProt and utilises bioinformatics tools such as the Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP) to create detailed variant annotations. These are presented in user friendly visualisations to help clinical experts interpret likely disease-associated variants identified in their patients.
Clinical centres can share variants and summary phenotype information from their patients through DECIPHER, enabling matching with other patients with similar conditions and collaboration between clinicians for patient benefit. With the help of DECIPHER, many thousands of patients now have a diagnosis and hundreds of papers are published every year improving understanding of rare diseases. By joining this project you will be playing an important role in advancing rare disease research, diagnosis, and discovery for genomic health.
Your role As the Bioinformatics Developer in the DECIPHER team, you will work alongside two software developers, a support specialist and the project leader to make the latest research data available for use in clinical settings. You will utilise your bioinformatics knowledge in assessment of resources, discussions with data producers and data analysis, reformatting, and integration tasks. This role offers the exciting opportunity to gain knowledge of clinical genomics and improved web development skills while creating tools to facilitate genomic medicine. You will see the real world impact of your work through interactions with our clinical collaborators and other DECIPHER stakeholders.
This role can be offered on a full-time or a part-time basis at 80% of full-time hours.
Your primary responsibilities will include:
Investigating, assessing and integrating molecular biology and phenotypic data in varying formats from public resources
Deploying bioinformatics tools in the DECIPHER environment and analysing genomic data
Designing, testing, implementing data structures and user interfaces to represent information relating to the human genome and genetic disorders.
Supporting DECIPHER users by responding to bug reports and requests for support or new features
Working with stakeholders to understand and translate their requirements into feature specifications
Performing ad hoc analyses to investigate potential data issues and support decision making
Liaising with other groups at EMBL-EBI and external collaborators to understand the resources they have created and how they could integrate with DECIPHER
Bringing bioinformatics expertise to the DECIPHER team and representing the DECIPHER project at internal and external meetings
You have Bachelors (or equivalent) degree in biological, clinical or computational sciences
Higher degree or equivalent experience in bioinformatics, software engineering or computational sciences
Experience of bioinformatics standards, tools and resources, preferably those relevant to variant annotation Experience of creating methods to manage and process genomics data
Experience designing and utilising large-scale relational databases, preferably with PostgreSQL.
Proficiency in a language used for data manipulation and analysis such as R and Python.
Familiarity with software development in JavaScript (preferably Node.js or browser-based).
Proficiency working in a UNIX/Linux environment.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to deliver a high-quality product to agreed deadlines.
Good communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to work closely with colleagues, giving and receiving constructive feedback
A professional and helpful manner when responding to support requests
You may also have
Experience of collaborating on development projects and working with colleagues from different disciplines.
Experience of working with and interpreting genomic/ molecular biology datasets
Experience in developing reactive, data-driven web applications in JavaScript frameworks such as Vue, React, or Angular.
Proficiency working in a HPC bioinformatics environment.

Experience of training people to use web tools or supporting users seeking assistance through a helpdesk system

Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.
**Position Summary**
Onfido, an Entrust company, is seeking a Principal Solutions Engineer to take technical ownership of a portfolio of EMEA Strategic Accounts and to act as the technical focal point for a set of partners in the United States. The role is split roughly 70% on EMEA Key Accounts and 30% on US leading identity and workforce platforms, and is based in the UK.
In this role you will represent the Entrust Identity Security platform with our largest and most demanding customers and partners, across regulated and fast growing industries including financial services, FinTech, payments, workforce verification and emerging use cases such as Know Your Employee (KYE). You will coordinate with C-level executives, product leaders, architects and developers, and you will be expected to lead the highly complex, multi-faceted technical conversations that others find difficult.
This is a hands on, customer facing role that blends problem solving, technical design, deep product knowledge and strong communication. As a Principal you will also mentor Solutions Engineers at all levels globally, influence our product roadmap for your market segments, and help shape the long term technical support model we put in place for partners. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding and Product across EMEA and AMER.
# **Responsibilities:**
# **EMEA Key Accounts (70% of the role)**
* Own the technical side of the customer relationship for a portfolio of EMEA Key Accounts, driving overall revenue retention and expansion, and the acquisition of new entities within those customers.
* Provide deep technical expertise to optimise customer integrations, product usage and product performance, guiding developers and architects through our API and SDKs.
* Drive adoption of new products and tablestake products into new use cases, new markets and new business lines within your accounts.
* Own RFPs and RFIs for your accounts, bringing technical, product and industry expertise.
* Own the success of trials, including defining success criteria and helping customers validate the solution with meaningful test plans and data flows.
* Run implementation workshops, support the initial assessment of customer issues, and work with CSM, Support and Onboarding on escalations that have a technical root cause.
* Explain in technical depth how the product behaves and how that impacts performance, and educate new stakeholders on our product details and inner capabilities.
* Act as a fraud thought leader with your accounts, and work with Product on the feature requests that matter most to our strategic customers.
# **USA Partners (30% of the role)**
* Support the sales motion for identity and workforce platforms with technical and product expertise, acting as the assigned technical focal point for their evaluation.
* Lead technical deep dives, workshops and proofs of concept with partner engineering, product and R&D teams, pulling in Applied Research, Engineering or Product when specialist input is needed.
* Lead the technical engagement when a partner starts to integrate, while engaging the Onboarding team early so that pure integration work transitions to them rather than sitting with the SE.
* Once a partner is integrated, build the ongoing technical relationship and trust that makes us their preferred provider among the multiple identity verification vendors they already integrate.
* Identify and articulate the product gaps that surface in partner engagements, and work with Product on paths to a solution within current product constraints.
* Help define the long term technical support model for partners in AMER, and feed back what works to the wider Go-to-Market organisation.
* Work US hours when needed from the UK to support partner engagements, and coordinate with US based Sales, Partner and Onboarding teams.
# **Across both parts of the role**
* Own product strategy input for your market segments: bring Product the insights from Key Accounts and partners, influence the roadmap, and lead the launch of new capabilities with early customers.
* Serve as subject matter expert for our more complex products, manage cross-product dependencies, and lead regulatory certification demos including direct coordination with regulators where needed.
* Mentor Solutions Engineers at all levels globally, guide junior teammates on complex deals, and drive the learning strategy in your domains of expertise across the global SE team and cross-functional teams.
* Build demos, industry specific presentations and example integrations tailored to Key Account and partner needs.
* Represent Onfido and Entrust Identity at company organised events, partner events, industry conferences and webinars.
# **Skills & Experience Required****:**
# **Essential**
* Substantial experience as a Pre sales, Sales Engineer or Solutions Engineer, including technical ownership of strategic or enterprise accounts of $1M+ ACV, or equivalent experience in Product Management with strong customer interaction.
* Experience acting as the technical counterpart for technology partners, ISVs or platform ecosystems, supporting evaluations and integrations rather than one-off transactions.
* Practical experience with at least one programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Java or Swift.
* Clear understanding of RESTful APIs and modern integration patterns.
* Ability to guide developers and technical teams through API and SDK integration.
* Strong sense of ownership and curiosity, with the autonomy to take technical ownership of strategic accounts and move complex, multi-stakeholder deals forward.
* Credibility and communication skills to coordinate directly with C-level stakeholders on both the customer and the partner side.
* Track record of mentoring or coaching other Solutions Engineers, and of sharing knowledge beyond your immediate team.
* Experience working directly with Sales while collaborating cross functionally with Customer Success, Product and Go to Market teams.
* Experience in cloud or SaaS companies.
* Fluent in English.
* Based in the UK and willing to work US hours when needed to support US partner engagements, with occasional travel to the United States.
**Desirable**
* Familiarity with identity verification, identity and access management, CIAM or fraud prevention technologies.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, regtech, payments or adjacent industries.
* Knowledge of security principles and data protection regulations.
* Experience working with customers and partners across multiple countries and regions.
* Experience in a technical account management role, or in post sales technical ownership of named accounts.
* Experience supporting regulatory certifications and dealing directly with regulators or assessors.
# # **Location and Travel**

You will support a portfolio of EMEA Key Accounts and a set of partners in the United States, and you will be expected to work US hours when needed to cover partner engagements. Travel within EMEA and occasional travel to the United States will be required for customer and partner meetings, workshops and industry events.

Reporting to the Architecture and Data Strategy Tribe Lead, the Enterprise and Business Architecture Practice Lead is a predominantly customer-facing role. We are rebuilding our platform, and we are looking for one person to own and drive the front end of it.
This is not a role where you pick up tickets and hand them back. You will set the standard for front-end architecture, decide how it is built, and be accountable for whether it is good. That is a considerable amount of responsibility. We are hiring someone who wants it.

What we care about is simple: you said you would do it, and it got done. Not hours at a desk. Not visible busyness. Done, to a standard you would defend in front of a tier-one bank's security team, because you may well have to.
If that reads as a warning, it is meant to. If it reads as the job you have been waiting for, keep going.
Who we are:
A UK events management SaaS company, based in Farringdon, with twenty years of stability and profit and a client list of large international enterprises across banking, automotive and law. Our customers operate in regulated sectors. The bar for what we ship is set by them, not by us.
The role
You will:
* Lead, drive and own the front-end architecture of our platform rebuild: the structure, the patterns, the component system, the performance budget. Not contribute to. Take the lead.
* Turn designs and wireframes into work you are prepared to put your name on.
* Set the standard for speed, scalability and responsiveness, and hold the line on it in review.
* Build the reusable libraries and patterns the rest of the team will work inside for the next five years.
* Raise the technical level of the engineers around you, through code review, pairing and example.
* Drive AI-assisted development across the team. We use Cursor and Claude seriously, not decoratively, and we invest in tooling and training. You will be expected to hold strong opinions on where AI accelerates delivery and where it quietly degrades quality.

* Five years or more building React.js and Next.js (14+) in production, ideally on a SaaS product.
* Deep JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3. Not framework deep, language deep.
* Real fluency with AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude for writing, reviewing, refactoring and documenting code, and the judgement to know when to switch them off.
* Git, and a working command of CI/CD, TDD/BDD and Agile/Kanban delivery.
* A track record you can point at: something you owned end to end, where the outcome was materially better because you were the one holding it.
* The communication to disagree with a stakeholder, explain the trade-off, and be understood.

Someone who wants a quiet seat at a stable company. We are a stable company, and there are quiet seats here. This is not one of them.

Send a CV, plus a few paragraphs answering two questions:
* Describe something you shipped that you owned end to end. What was hard about it, what did you get wrong, and what would you do differently?

**The Position**
You are a technical voice the Engineering organization trusts and follows. You are part of a community of FanDuel's most senior Engineers, focused on the organization's most complex and ambiguous problems: shaping our future architecture, setting technical expectations and guidance, and setting and maintaining the highest engineering standards.
You guide, influence and are accountable for the final technical call on choices that affect hundreds of engineers across multiple domains and verticals. You embody our principle Challenge and Commit and have proven experience in judging when to look for consensus and when the call is yours to make. You know how to communicate and connect successfully at scale, in person and asynchronously.
You regularly interact with executives up to the c-suite, distilling the essentials from a complex technical strategy and folding business strategy into our technical direction.
You own the technical strategy for the CPE engineering domain, with ownership & responsibility for technical architecture (current and target state), operational excellence and engineering standards.
CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalization, and marketing messaging that shape every fan's day-to-day experience. That means designing for extreme peak load that spikes around live events, and for a heavily regulated environment where auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. You take a leadership role on the domain's most important work, balancing a long view against short-term demands and taking a pragmatic approach to architectural design. Your work always follows our principle - Everything Begins with the Customer.
You do not accept the status quo, and you strongly influence other domains and verticals, and the organization's "North Star" technical strategy. You will spend some of your time working with the Principal Community and other senior Engineers to set the standard for how AI is used across the SDLC, including where we choose not to use it, and to shape our engineering practices, back-end and front-end architecture, FanDuel's product suite, our tools, approaches and processes. You wear your FanDuel hat first and foremost; you do not restrict yourself to organizational boundaries - We are One team.
You mentor and support our Senior Staff Engineers, themselves highly experienced, and serve as a role model to our engineering community and a visible part of how the domain is run. You are Humble and Hungry.
**What We're Looking For**
* Expert-level experience building and designing scalable, fault-tolerant and highly available systems, including systems under extreme peak load that spikes around live events
* Experience influencing technical direction across 200+ person Engineering organizations
* Expert-level understanding of engineering design patterns and architectural approaches.
* Deep, current, hands-on command of AI-assisted software development: agentic coding and spec-driven development workflows, the context and tooling that make them work, and review, testing and verification practices that hold up as code volume rises
* A proven track record taking an engineering organization past experimentation to a measured change in how software is built: setting the standards for where AI is and is not used, evidence of the effect on throughput, quality and security, and the judgment to tell real uplift from theatre. Able to do this in a regulated environment, where auditability and data boundaries constrain what AI is allowed to touch
* Experienced in making pragmatic tradeoffs between short-term needs and long-term needs
* Able to build trust and shared understanding with teams and engineers who do not report to you
* Deep experience in modern back-end languages, functional and object-oriented, including Java
* Demonstrated ability to raise operational excellence and best practice through influence and collaboration
What You'll Do
* Take ownership of CPE's domain architecture, aligning the domain's Senior Staff Engineers on a target technical architecture and strategy
* Take ownership of the domain's operational excellence, taking a hands-on approach to the resolution of its most complex issues when needed. This includes supporting resolution and mitigation of production incidents, and the corrective actions that prevent them recurring.
* Write simple code, taking complex paradigms and implementing them in a way that Engineers at all levels can understand and contribute to. You set the pattern through prototypes and reference implementations rather than owning feature delivery. Insist on high standards for code quality while not letting perfection be the enemy of the good
* Influence the delivery of the domain's teams and their Staff and Senior Staff Engineers, helping them understand how to make technical tradeoff decisions between short-term business needs and long-term technology needs
* Drive engineering best practices (e.g., Operational Excellence, Security, Quality) and set standards for the CPE domain
* Help others leverage your expertise, by coaching and mentoring Senior Staff Engineers in your organization
* Support our software as part of the domain's senior escalation tier, rather than the primary on-call rotation
**What You Can Expect**
* Interesting work - working in a fast-paced and ever-changing industry, new problems and exciting solutions are never too far away. There are always opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your horizons
* A sense of achievement - Our teams own their own software and when that awesome new feature ships to users and the positive feedback starts rolling in, you can feel really proud of what you and your team created
* Personal development - clear and defined career pathways for every role at every level, a supportive manager, loads of learning opportunities and even 10% of your time to dedicate to your learning
* Belonging - everyone at FanDuel works for each other, we win together, make mistakes together and have lots of fun doing it
* Trust - A trusting work environment where productivity is valued above all else, giving you autonomy and ownership of your time and work
* Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy along with a number of other benefits

# Grid Lead (Development)
**Background**
Field has entered its next phase of growth. In June, Ofgem selected 16 long-duration energy storage projects to progress to delivery - Field was awarded 5 of them. Collectively, these projects represent roughly double the MWh capacity of all battery storage installed in the UK to date. Field currently has 4 projects, totalling over 1GWh, in construction in GB, with plenty more delivery ahead. Field also has 6 operational projects across GB and Germany.
Field is exploring novel technologies too, drawing on its development experience to capitalise on global trends.
Exceptional talent is what makes all of this possible.
## Key Responsibilities
**Your Mission**
As a Grid Lead, you will have responsibility across Field's GB Development portfolio - from origination through to pre-construction. You'll be a go-to expert for electrical and grid queries across the business; feeding directly into design during early development, managing relationships with NESO and Transmission Owners, leading early-stage grid compliance work and shaping the company's stance on grid compliance across the whole portfolio.
This is a highly technical, highly autonomous role. You'll combine deep power systems and grid connection expertise with commercial judgement. It's also a collaborative role, working closely with the Origination team, Development Project Managers and Project Engineers.
If you're looking for an exciting role, working on a secured portfolio of real, transmission-scale projects and helping define how Field continues to develop in the grid connections space, this is it. Our projects are large-scale, high-value and at the forefront of the energy transition. **What you’ll be doing**
Management of grid connections for origination and development projects and novel technologies, including:
* Understanding the grid-related opportunities and risks of each development project;
* Providing electrical design expertise during early project development;
* Preparation of single line diagrams (SLDs) and general arrangement drawings;
* Management of grid connection applications, from application through to acceptance and modifications; and
* Stakeholder engagement with NESO and the relevant Transmission Owners (TOs).
Industry intelligence and pipeline strategy, including:
* Sharing key industry developments in grid connections — including Connections Reform and CUSC modifications — with the wider business, and making recommendations to directly shape the GB pipeline;
* Maintaining expert knowledge of the existing and future GB electricity network; and
* Keeping abreast of developments in the grid landscape to spot opportunities for what to develop next, and where, and advising the wider business accordingly.
Power systems engineering expertise and grid compliance for pre-construction projects, including:
* Oversee the procurement of early stage grid compliance studies to feed directly into site designs;
* Ownership of the early G99 and ONCC connection application processes, including P28 and G5/5 reports to inform the final project design for procurement;
* Acting as the go-to contact for Project Managers, providing recommendations based on the impact of grid issues on budgets and programme; and
* On-going liaison with TOs and NESO to resolve issues as they arise.
## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
**The skills you’ll need**
* Electrical Engineering degree (or equivalent) with 6+ years’ experience within a grid connections, power systems or electrical engineering role in BESS, power generation or a related infrastructure sector;
* A sense of entrepreneurialism, strong commercial awareness and a solid understanding of transmission grid connections and wider project development lifecycles;
* Strong working knowledge of the G99 and ONCC connection application processes, confidence reviewing P28 and G5/5 reports, and familiarity with Grid Code
* Proven ability to build and cultivate productive working relationships with NESO and TO representatives
* Up to date knowledge of grid-related industry developments, including Connections Reform and CUSC modifications
* Excellent communication skills. You should be comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders, including Field’s Senior Leadership Team
* Ability to work autonomously
## Benefits
**Package Details**
Salary: £100,000 - £118,000
We’re offering a competitive compensation package, including participation in our employee share scheme which rewards all employees for the growth of the business. You’ll be awarded shares when you join, which will vest over four years - and as the business grows in size and value, so will your shares!
We value our team’s wellbeing and belonging so we invest approx £5,000 a year on a range of perks, benefits and wellbeing activities, including regular team socials and events.
Other benefits include
* Up to 10% Company wide bonus based on company performance
* Hybrid working (blend of home and office working to suit individual needs)
* £2,000 per year to spend on your professional development
* Private medical cover with Bupa from day one with the option to add family members.
* Company Pension with 8% Contribution
* Enhanced parental leave, for all new parents:
+ 6 months fully paid primary carer leave
+ 3 months fully paid secondary carer leave
+ 10 days fully paid leave for fertility treatment
* Fun co-working office space in Shoreditch, London
* 1 month work from anywhere, for those with a travel bug
* 1 day green leave to do something good for the environment
* Free lunch once a week - a great way to get to know people in the wider team
* Dog-friendly office, feel free to bring your pooch along
* Spill: our mental health benefit allowing every Fielder access to equal and unrestricted therapy and resources
* Regular, optional team socials designed to be inclusive for everyone (not just the pub goers!)
* Birthday carbon offset: a gift from Field to the world to celebrate your birthday
**A bit about Field**
Field builds, owns and operates renewable energy infrastructure. We develop grid-scale BESS sites across the UK, Italy, Spain, and Germany, backed, so far, by a £265 million investment from CVC DIF. Our mission is to continue to grow internationally and develop a strong global BESS portfolio.
Batteries have a big job to do. They store renewable energy for when it's needed most, reducing grid intermittency and displacing carbon-intensive generation. Without storage, renewables can't scale — and we're here to change that. We have 300 MWh operational, >1 GWh under construction, and tens of GWh in development.
We're a team of experts in our fields — from engineers and construction managers to traders and data scientists — who roll up their sleeves and move fast. We're curious, we share openly, and we're genuinely motivated by the mission.
We are an eclectic team with diverse backgrounds, from scaling billion-dollar tech startups to building energy companies and specialising in energy markets. You'll work with fun, curious, entrepreneurial people making a real impact. We're proving batteries are a viable energy solution now. Our ambitious plans include becoming Europe's leading clean energy player and expanding beyond batteries into new assets
**Our Values**
* **Work for the team** - We are friendly and approachable. We make time for each other, value diverse perspectives, and learn and grow together.
* **Do it right** - We prioritise doing things right, never cutting corners. Safety comes first, and we consider our impact on communities and the environment. We act with integrity always.
* **Move fast** - We’re doers. We take responsibility, deliver on promises, and get things done. FAST.
* **Know your stuff** - We’re curious self-starters, always learning, adapting, and improving. No question is too small. We own our growth.
Read more about our values at www.field.energy
Love the sound of Field but not sure this role is right for you? Have a look at our careers page and register your CV. We are always interested in candidates who have exposure to BESS and work within the Renewable Energy space. We’d love to hear from you

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! # **Senior Director, R&D AI & Technology Transformation**
R&D Tech Transformation & Operations connects strategy, investment and delivery across priority R&D technology programmes. The team works with scientific, technology and business leaders to strengthen decisions, accelerate value and support consistent adoption across R&D.
This role strengthens a portfolio of priority R&D technology programmes by connecting programme teams with R&D technology strategy and investment decisions. You will work closely with selected programmes, bringing constructive challenge, strategic support, and external market insight. You will help teams frame choices, define value and address barriers without taking accountability away from programme owners. We expect to appoint two Senior Directors through this recruitment, with complementary experience across research and drug development technology.
For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. The location of this role will therefore subsequently change to Cambridge, UK in accordance with timelines to be set by the Company. The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.
**In this role you will**
* Partner with leaders of selected priority technology programmes to clarify strategy, scope, value objectives, roadmaps and organisational needs.
* Provide an independent, evidence-based view of programme progress, risks and value delivery to support Technology Investment Board decisions.
* Apply a high-challenge, high-support approach, bringing transparency while helping teams solve strategic problems and remove barriers.
* Lead focused work on questions such as build, buy or partner choices, capability sourcing, operating models and external technology landscapes.
* Assess which capabilities could create competitive advantage and which can be sourced effectively from external partners.
* Help shape new technology initiatives, including their business case, funding approach, value definition, governance and delivery model.
* Connect learning across programmes, identify opportunities for reuse and reduce unnecessary duplication of technology capabilities.
* Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technology and business leaders, influencing decisions without direct authority.
* Translate between scientific, operational and technical stakeholders so that complex choices become clear and actionable.
* Contribute directly to strategic projects related to the wider portfolio while programme delivery accountability remains with programme owners.
# Why you?
**Basic qualifications**
**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**
* Degree or equivalent experience in technology, computer science, life sciences, engineering, business or a related discipline.
* Significant experience leading strategic technology, AI or digital transformation work in a large pharmaceutical environment.
* Strong knowledge of drug research or development and the ability to work credibly with scientific, operational and technology leaders.
* Demonstrated experience shaping and delivering cross-functional strategic projects in complex organisations.
* Experience evaluating technology capabilities, operating models, partnerships or build-versus-buy decisions.
* Ability to use structured analysis to develop recommendations and support implementation.
* Executive-level communication and influencing skills, including confidence working with Vice Presidents and other senior leaders.
* Evidence of hands-on contribution, sound judgement and effective delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
**Preferred Qualifications & Skills:**
**Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:**
* Experience in management consulting, particularly strategy, technology or life sciences consulting.
* Experience moving from consulting into pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life-sciences technology roles.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled research or development solutions, clinical development technology, regulatory technology, data platforms or scientific technology.
* Product, portfolio or investment experience within pharmaceutical R&D, biotechnology, a contract research organisation or a life-sciences technology company.
* Experience working with external vendors, technology partners or innovation ecosystems.

A PROPOS DU POSTE:
Au sein de la Direction Médicale Respiratoire - Inflammation - Immunologie, vos missions seront les suivantes:
- Assure le rôle d'expert médical sur son/ses produits auprès de ses interlocuteurs en externe et en interne (marketing et ventes, Groupe / filiale) tant pour les activités affaires médicales que pour le soutien médical au développement clinique.

- Veille au respect des règles de la gouvernance médicale pour ce qui concerne les activités d'engagement scientifique et de communication médicale et scientifique pour les produits thérapeutiques qui lui sont confiés.
- S'assure du respect de l'éthique, des principes de " Scientific Engagement (SE) " et du code de conduite pour toutes les actions entreprises.
VOS RESPONSABILITES:
Stratégie Médicale:
- Contribue avec l'équipe médicale du département à la veille scientifique et concurrentielle (participation congrès, presse médicale,...) des produits et pathologies de sa (ses) gamme(s;
− Participe à la mise en oeuvre sur le plan médical des plans de développement locaux ou proposés par le Groupe GSK, en collaboration avec les Opérations Cliniques, particulièrement sur les études identifiées comme stratégiques;
− Participe à la réflexion médicale stratégique, élabore et met en oeuvre le Médical Plan (y compris le plan EE, ad board,...) du (des) produits qui lui sont confiés ;
Recherche clinique:
− Est à même d'apporter son expertise /ses connaissances médicales en soutien aux Opérations clinques dans le déroulé des essais cliniques, sans être décisionnel;
− Contribue à la gestion locale du risque et assure une surveillance médicale de laqualité associés aux études cliniques.
Affaires médicales:
− Contribue avec l'équipe médicale du département à la veille scientifique et concurrentielle (participation congrès, presse médicale,...) des produits et pathologies de sa gamme;
− Responsable de l'organisation des réunions des comités d'experts, sous la responsabilité du DMAT et/ou du RM;
− Responsable du contenu et de l'organisation scientifique des manifestations scientifiques initiées par GSK (symposiums, conférence de presse);
− Apporte la contribution médicale à l'élaboration des documents promotionnels;
− Rédige les documents de communication scientifique (Medical Comments, réponses à Objections, compte-rendu de congrès,...) pour la visite médicale et s'assure de leur validation et documentation;
− Contribue à l'élaboration des diaporamas des RMRs;
− Développe et entretient des relations avec les experts externes de son domaine thérapeutique: s'assure de leur connaissance de nos produits en fonction de leur demande et lorsque nécessaire et en accord avec les règles du SE et de l'accompagnement des dossiers d'AMM et post-AMM (HAS);
− Participe à la formation initiale et continue des RMR, de la direction des Opérations cliniques, de la visite médicale, des équipes marketing;
− Participe aux réunions transversales avec les équipes commerciales sur le suivi de la performance et de la mise en oeuvre des plans opérationnels des produits qui lui sont confiés (Launch team, com cell, ...)
Gouvernance Médicale et contrôle des risques:
− Assure toutes ses activités dans le respect des règles de la gouvernance médicale pour ce qui concerne notamment l'engagement scientifique et le code de pratiques
− Participe à la réalisation des contrôles de niveau 1 au sein de son département

- Médecin ou pharmacien et autre profil par exception (dans ce cas une formation scientifique de haut niveau est requise ainsi qu'une expérience dans une fonction médicale au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique).
- Anglais (TOEIC > 700)
- Expertise médicale dans le domaine souhaité.
- Pratique médicale d'au moins 1 à 3 ans (activité hospitalière ou libérale) et/ou expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique (recherche clinique et/ou médico marketing)
- Expérience d'organisation de manifestations scientifiques et de gestion d'experts
- Aptitude à la gestion de projets
- Qualités de représentation & communication (prise de parole en public)
- Organisation et esprit de synthèse
- Capacité à diriger un groupe de travail et à travailler en équipe
Selon votre niveau d'expérience et d'expertise, le poste sera en grade 7 ou 6.
Chez GSK, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer directement à l'amélioration de la santé des patients grâce à vos compétences en data et en gestion stratégique. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement tourné vers l'innovation où collaboration, rigueur scientifique et technologie avancée sont au coeur des opérations.
Rejoignez-nous dès aujourd'hui et participez à la transformation des données médicales en solutions stratégiques pour le bien-être des patients et l'avancement de la science.

Nous investissons dans quatre domaines thérapeutiques essentiels (maladies infectieuses, VIH, oncologie et immunologie) et saisissons toutes les opportunités futures qui peuvent avoir un impact sur la santé à grande échelle. **Discovery Disease Area Lead, Cardiovascular-Renal Diseases**
At GSK, we are dedicated to improving the quality of human life by leveraging scientific advancements to develop better medicines with reduced attrition. Through our Discovery Disease Area Leads (DDALs), we enable target identification, selection, and validation at scale, driving innovation and excellence across our R&D landscape.
As the Discovery Disease Area Lead, Cardiovascular-Renal, you will be at the forefront of our mission, driving the discovery and validation of therapeutic targets for a range of diseases, such as chronic kidney disease, glomerulonephritis and cardiovascular conditions that are associated with metabolic dysfunction. You will lead a cross-functional, highly matrixed team of scientists, clinical staff, and pharma experts to identify and validate high-quality targets using large-scale experimental and in silico approaches. Your efforts will ultimately contribute to translating human disease phenotype information into actionable therapeutic innovations.
Location: This role will be based at one of GSK’s R&D hub sites, in Stevenage, UK, or Upper Providence, PA, USA. The Discovery Disease Area Lead, Cardiovascular-Renal will be expected to spend at least 2-3 days / week on site.
For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. The location of this role will therefore subsequently change to Cambridge, UK in accordance with timelines to be set by the Company. The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Portfolio Execution –**
* **Portfolio Generation and Oversight:** Generate and oversee the pre-Commit to Target (C2T) project portfolio in the Renal and Cardio-Renal therapy area.
* **Target Delivery:** Systematically deliver pools of high-potential targets that fulfill all C2T quality criteria based on therapeutic area-defined target medicine profiles for bespoke target validation
* **Senior Management Interface:** Influence Senior R&D management by identifying and communicating portfolio risks and opportunities.
* **Strategy Execution:** Drive development and implementation of key components of the renal and cardio-renal research strategy in R&D Tech for the Research Units.
* **Team Representation:** Ensure appropriate representation of lines/functions within the operational matrix team.
**Cardiovascular / renal / metabolic disease expertise -**
* **Nephrology and/or Cardiovascular Expertise:** Apply deep experience in renal and cardio-renal disease indications drug discovery, focusing on clinically relevant target identification through human-first discovery approaches.
* **Scientific Excellence:** Drive best-in-class science across R&D Technologies and Research Units (RUs).
* **Strategic Partnership:** Partner proactively with Research Units and R&D Technology Leadership to provide strategic scientific input into disease phenotype discovery and therapeutic target identification.
* **External Engagement**: Maintain connection with renal biology experts, KOLs, and societies to ensure solid strategic guidance on emerging therapeutics, understanding which could impact the portfolio and priorities.
* **Clinical Insight:** General understanding of clinical treatments for renal, cardio-renal and associated diseases and emerging innovative trial design and biomarkers.
* **Business Case Development:** Lead the creation of strong business cases that align with RU and R&D Tech strategies.
* **External Opportunities Assessment:** Collaborate with Business Development to assess external opportunities.
**Strategic Alignment –**
* **Framework Adherence:** Ensure adherence to decision frameworks up to C2T, incorporating relevant stakeholders.
* **Resource Coordination:** Coordinate resources from RDTech and RUs to cover all steps from the patient identification, strategic ideation, target screening, triage, large-scale validation, and presentation.
* **Risk Management:** Elevate resource challenges, project risks, pipeline risks, and opportunities to RDTech LT.
* **Resource Allocation:** Make recommendations to department heads (RDTech and RUs) on areas to reduce, postpone, or stop.
***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications & Skills:**
**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**
* **Education:** Minimum of PhD degree or extensive (15+ years) drug discovery and development experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 15 years of progressive pharmaceutical experience required, including key project leadership roles in programs that progressed to the clinic and/or approval for renal / cardiovascular indications.
* **Leadership Skills:** Proven track record of exceptional team and cross-functional leadership.
* **R&D Expertise:** Experience with renal or cardiovascular R&D programs, scientific and clinical strategies.
* **Research Program Design**: Ability to design a comprehensive drug discovery program to reach a critical milestone
* **Data Interpretation:** Strong data interpretation and report writing/presentation skills.
* **Global Mindset:** Demonstrated ability to assimilate complex science quickly and work globally.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Ability to work cross-functionally, cross-geography, and with high-level managers and executives.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent executive communication skills.
* **Time Management:** Ability to manage multiple demands and priorities on time, lead teams, gain alignment, and drive decision-making.
* **Networking:** Access to internal and external networks of experts.
* **Travel Requirement:** Up to 20% travel (mostly international).

Personal data is all information that can be directly or indirectly linked to a living, physical person. Examples of personal data are: name, e-mail address, telephone number and IP address. Processing of personal data is any automated use of personal data - such as collecting, creating, analyzing, sharing, and deleting personal data.
There are laws and regulations on how companies may process personal data, so-called data protection laws. Different data protection laws apply to different types of use of personal data, and in different parts of the world. An example of a data protection law that is relevant for our use of your personal data, as described in this privacy policy, is the EU Data Protection Regulation (2016/679, "GDPR").
Most obligations under the GDPR apply to the so-called data controller. A data controller is the entity that decides for which purposes personal data will be processed, and how the processing will be executed. The data controller can use a so-called data processor. A data processor is an entity that is only allowed to process personal data as instructed by the data controller, and may not use the personal data for its own purposes.

In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.
A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.
Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.
Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.
## **Role Overview 📝**
The Day Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. As the Day Ops Manager, you are accountable for site performance during your shift—end-to-end across under-the-roof and on-the-road operations.
For on-the-road, you will manage and lead driver set-off in the morning while proactively supporting drivers and their service levels throughout the day. In the depot, you will oversee any daytime under-the-roof activities and bridges required from the previous day/week, as well as forward labour planning.
You will lead a team of Coordinators and you will need to have the highest standards of professionalism and discipline, leading by example in every moment. This is an on-site role embedded in the day-to-day operations. **The shifts for this role are a 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern which will require you to work one day on the weekend.** Our Operations team is organised into roles at different levels: this is a level 5 role reporting into the site leader.
## **What you’ll be doing 🚀**
* Lead shift during rotation - managing Shift Managers, Coordinators, Fleet Specialist - to deliver exceptional OTR & UTR day-time performance.
* Receive handover from Night Manager, deliver handover to mid-Shift Manager.
* Be the GM’s primary support & deliver strong handovers
* Lead & inspire, & develop and performance manage, team on OM’s shift rotation.

+ DSP management - DSP Capacity, Account management relationships, and performance management.
+ HIVED Partner Driver Capacity and pool management (Plan vs Actual).
+ HIVED Partner Driver service level management
+ Legal compliance (hours on road, breaks, safety checks).

+ Labour planning for week-ahead & night.
+ Managing day activities, e.g. sortation as relevant, preparation for sortation.
* Succession planning for week ahead + 6-week glance for their side of the week, & peaks.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives & Develop standards and operating procedures.

* 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced OTR / dispatch / last-mile operations.

**Role Overview**
The ServiceNow Data and CMDB Specialist is responsible for the governance, quality and ongoing development of data held within the ServiceNow platform, with particular responsibility for the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), service data, and reporting and insight delivered through or sourced from ServiceNow.
The role makes sure Configuration Items (CIs), their relationships and supporting service data are accurate, complete and kept up to date. This provides a reliable source of information for service management processes, operational decision-making, risk management, automation and the introduction of new services and technologies.
The role also oversees the quality of data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems. Working with source-system owners and integration teams, the role holder establishes clear ownership, agreed data standards and appropriate controls. They do not own the source systems but are responsible for identifying and coordinating the resolution of issues that affect the quality of data used within ServiceNow.
ServiceNow is an enterprise-wide platform supporting Business Teams and functions across the firm, including Information Technology, M&BD, Finance, People, Knowledge, the Office of the General Counsel, Operations and Communications. It operates across one production and four sub-production instances and includes a broad range of ServiceNow products, custom scoped applications and enterprise integrations. The Service Portal is available to all users across the firm.
The right candidate brings practical ServiceNow CMDB and reporting experience, strong analytical skills and the ability to build effective working relationships. They are comfortable managing their own workload, investigating complex data issues and making recommendations based on the available evidence.
**Key Responsibilities**
Specific duties or responsibilities may be reviewed from time to time to reflect changes in personnel and management structure, staff location or services. All members of the firm participate in our Responsible Business program.
* Own the governance, quality and ongoing maturity of the ServiceNow CMDB, making sure CI data and relationships are accurate, complete, current and fit for purpose, and maintain the CMDB data model, CI classes, attributes, relationships and lifecycle standards in line with ServiceNow best practice and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Own the service mapping data model, governance and quality standards, working with service owners and Platform Engineering to make sure business applications, application services, technical services and supporting infrastructure are recorded and related at the appropriate level.
* Work with service, application, infrastructure and data owners to agree ownership, data requirements and responsibilities for maintaining configuration and service data, and maintain appropriate controls for creating, updating, reconciling, retiring and deleting CIs.
* Monitor CMDB health through regular data-quality reviews covering completeness, correctness, compliance, duplication, stale records and missing or inaccurate relationships, investigate root causes and work with the relevant owners to agree and track corrective action.
* Establish governance standards for data supplied to ServiceNow by other systems, including authoritative sources, ownership, definitions, quality expectations and frequency of updates, and maintain a clear record of the main data sources, owners, integration dependencies and agreed controls.
* Work with source-system owners and integration teams to understand how data moves between systems, monitor and reconcile data received through inbound feeds and integrations, and coordinate corrective action where issues are found.
* Consider data-governance requirements when new integrations, services and automation are being designed, and work with the Principal ServiceNow Developer, ServiceNow Solutions Developer and Senior ServiceNow Platform Specialist to make sure integrations, discovery sources, imports and automated feeds update ServiceNow data correctly.
* Define and validate CMDB and data requirements for platform changes and integrations, and support the effective use of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping and other tools used to populate and maintain the CMDB.
* Work with asset owners to maintain appropriate alignment between configuration and asset data, without taking ownership of the underlying asset-management processes.

* Help build a supportive workplace where colleagues can do their best work and take part in the firm's Responsible Business program.

job_description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces. We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.
Ready to join us?
Your Role
We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.
As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:
Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.
Location
Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.
Must-Haves
An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
